manifest.duration_policy: Sum of per-case fail-safe maxima may exceed the whole-trial cap. Admission reserves the next case maximum plus cleanup reserve against the original trial deadline. Any unadmitted case remains NOT_RUN, and an incomplete run cannot close the investigation.
manifest.sample_policy: Round-robin by repetition; reverse the declared case order on alternate repetitions. Each sample is a fresh process. No p95. Root controls disable timing hooks while preserving correctness, body counters and resource monitoring.

limits: disk growth uses shared runner filesystem free-space changes; unrelated writes may conservatively stop setup
sampled at0.5seconds, not a hard disk quota or network byte meter
package input acquisition additionally uses the existing preparer's narrower artifact/time limits
private command logs and dependency payloads are not uploaded
prerequisites.network_scope: existing Python requirements and existing native Docker CI recipes; no model or forge provider

scope: one original trial only; original sample order, statuses and raw wall/CPU values retained; no pooling
phase count, outcomes and timing aggregates retain inclusive observations; nested or overlapping phases are not additive partitions
phase timing minima and maxima describe observed intervals; missing intervals remain explicitly missing
process timelines and individual span identities are omitted; resource summaries and missing/unavailable counts remain
source summaries are retained as reported; sample values permit independent median/range recalculation
the projection is evidence preservation, not acceptance of a run, optimization, distribution or release
pattern screening does not replace independent review of public facts and their source provenance
